page: Running Hono on Tencent CloudBase serverless platform using Node.js process. HTTP Cloud Functions listen on port 9000, started via scf_bootstrap. @hono/node-server works without extra adapter. Setup: npm create hono@latest my-app, select nodejs template. Hello World: serve() from @hono/node-server with port 9000. Run: npm run dev, access http://localhost:9000. Bootstrap script: scf_bootstrap (LF line endings, executable) with /var/lang/node20/bin/node path. Deploy: build with npm run build, use tcb fn deploy <function-name> --httpFn via CloudBase CLI. Node.js 20.19 runtime. Questions: How do I set up Hono on Tencent CloudBase? What port does CloudBase use? How do I create bootstrap script? How do I deploy?

sections.manifest: Setup for Tencent CloudBase. Create project: npm create hono@latest my-app (or yarn, pnpm, bun variants). Select nodejs template. Install dependencies: npm i. Questions: How do I create project? Which template?

Hello World on CloudBase. File: src/index.ts. Imports: serve from '@hono/node-server', Hono. Port requirement: 9000 for CloudBase. Code: Hono app with serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port: 9000 }). Run: npm run dev, access http://localhost:9000. No extra adapter needed. Questions: What port is required? How do I set up serve? What's the app structure?
Development server. Command: npm run dev. Access: http://localhost:9000. Local development ready. Questions: How do I run dev server?

scf_bootstrap file for CloudBase. Location: project root. Permissions: executable (chmod +x scf_bootstrap). Line endings: LF required. Content: #!/bin/bash followed by /var/lang/node20/bin/node dist/index.js. Node path: matches runtime (node20 for Node.js 20.19). File has no extension. Questions: What's scf_bootstrap? Where do I put it? What's the content? Why LF line endings?

Deployment to Tencent CloudBase. Build: npm run build compiles code to dist. Deploy: tcb fn deploy <function-name> --httpFn (CloudBase CLI). Runtime: Node.js 20.19. Alternative: console zip upload (see Node.js HTTP function quick start). Reference: CloudBase CLI documentation. Questions: How do I build? How do I deploy? Which runtime? Alternative upload?
